validation_scope: Source reconstruction, native Bybit monthly-file acquisition, causal pivot availability, completed-bar sequencing, Breaker/FVG overlap, first-retest lifecycle, next-open entry, structural exits, one-global-slot account replay, cost stress and stage seals.
evidence: Engine source reconstructed to 61159 bytes and SHA-256 5119e93bf56b4cb8a7cfcd0ea206fd98d77a5d76c1f39f6617af1272a516fec5 before compilation.
Built-in deterministic causal self-test passed with exactly 128 unique candidates.
Project harness passed in GitHub Actions run 30192218575.
Forty-eight native Bybit monthly one-minute files covering four allowed symbols in 2022 were acquired and recorded with compressed SHA-256, row counts and timestamp bounds.
A complete UTC minute grid was used without forward fill, interpolation or timeline compression.
Pivots were usable only after right-side confirmation; entry occurred at the next contiguous open after a completed first-retest signal.

One global slot, 0.5-percent NAV risk sizing, 3x notional cap, prior-turnover capacity and identical 12/18/24-bps paths were enforced.
All 128 candidates were negative even at 12 bps; no concentration counterfactual was needed to determine the economic failure.
2023 and every 2024-2026 period remained unopened; no credential or order path was used.
known_limitations: One-minute bar execution proxy rather than point-in-time Bybit BBO/depth.
Adverse fixed funding-boundary reserve rather than exact historical funding cashflow.
